how_pinned: Hub API /api/models/Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B?blobs=true read 2026-11-09 for the revision, git blob IDs and LFS sha256; files fetched with `hf download --revision 97b0c614…` (huggingface_hub 1.16.4) and every sha256 below recomputed locally with shasum -a 256 on neo

checkpoint.names: embed_tokens.weight [151669,1024], norm.weight [1024], and per block layers.N.{input_layernorm,post_attention_layernorm}.weight [1024], self_attn.{q_norm,k_norm}.weight [128], self_attn.q_proj [2048,1024], k_proj/v_proj [1024,1024], o_proj [1024,2048], mlp.{gate,up}_proj [3072,1024], mlp.down_proj [1024,3072]; no 'model.' prefix, no lm_head

architecture.source: transformers modeling_qwen3.py and modeling_rope_utils.py (read in a local transformers 4.57.6 install; config.json names 4.51.3), Apache-2.0
architecture.attention: causal (is_causal = True); per-head RMSNorm of Q and K over head_dim before RoPE, none on V; scaling head_dim**-0.5; KV head of query head h is h / (16/8)
architecture.rope: default type, inv_freq = 1/(theta**(arange(0,128,2)/128)) in float32, angle = position*inv_freq in float32, NEOX rotate_half (pairs i, i+64); positions = cache_position = arange(seq_len) when no position_ids are passed, also under padding
architecture.rmsnorm: x * rsqrt(mean(x**2) + eps) in float32, then weight * that; no +1 offset
architecture.block: x + o(attn(input_layernorm(x))); then x + down(silu(gate(n)) * up(n)) with n = post_attention_layernorm(x)
architecture.output: last_hidden_state = norm(x) after block 28; no head is used

tokenizer.type: byte-level BPE (tokenizers): model BPE, byte_fallback false, ignore_merges false, continuing_subword_prefix '', end_of_word_suffix '', unk_token null
tokenizer.pre_tokenizer: Sequence[Split(Regex, behavior Isolated, invert false), ByteLevel(add_prefix_space false, use_regex false)]
tokenizer.bos: none: add_bos_token false, bos_token null, no BOS in the template
tokenizer.tokenizer_config_eos_token: <|im_end|> (151645); not the token the post-processor appends

pooling.modules: modules.json: 0 Transformer, 1 1_Pooling, 2 2_Normalize (sentence_transformers.models.Normalize; it has no files, the directory is absent from the repository)
pooling.last_token_rule: sentence-transformers 5.1.0 Pooling: values, indices = attention_mask.flip(1).max(1); gather position seq_len - indices - 1, the last position whose mask is 1, for left or right padding
pooling.readme_transformers_recipe: last_token_pool: with left padding the last column, otherwise attention_mask.sum(1) - 1; tokenizer padding_side='left'; F.normalize(p=2, dim=1)
pooling.eos_and_padding: the post-processor appends <|endoftext|> to every sequence, so the pooled position is that token; padding uses the same ID (pad_token <|endoftext|>) but carries mask 0 and is never pooled

prompts.query:

prompts.readme_format: get_detailed_instruct: f'Instruct: {task_description}\nQuery:{query}' (no space after 'Query:'); documents carry no instruction
prompts.readme_inconsistency: the card's TEI curl example writes 'Query: ' with a space; the pinned prompt and the Transformers recipe have none, and this encoder follows them

sentence_transformers_behavior.source: sentence-transformers v5.1.0 models/Transformer.py and models/Pooling.py, read 2026-11-09
sentence_transformers_behavior.strip: Transformer.tokenize applies str(s).strip() to prompt + text; the Transformers recipe does not strip, so this encoder's text mode refuses leading or trailing whitespace
sentence_transformers_behavior.max_seq_length: min(max_position_embeddings 32768, tokenizer.model_max_length 131072) = 32768; the repository has no sentence_bert_config.json
sentence_transformers_behavior.truncation: longest_first at max_seq_length; this encoder refuses instead of truncating
